titulo: Figure a 20% tip in your head: slide the decimal, then double
receta: cuenta simple con la plata de todos los días + regla para guardar (mover la coma y duplicar)
destinatario: Se lo manda alguien que hace la cuenta de la propina de cabeza a su amigo que saca la calculadora en la mesa.

interaccion.guardar: 20% tip: slide the decimal one spot left (10%), then double it. 15%: 10% plus half of it.
interaccion.comentar: What do you usually tip? Give me a percent.

frases.texto: You pull out your phone to figure out the tip. You don't need to.

frases.estilo: Dry and punchy, with a half smile.

frases.texto: Say the bill is fifty dollars. Slide the decimal one spot left. That's ten percent: five dollars.
Now double it. Ten dollars. That's twenty percent.
Want fifteen? Take the ten percent and add half of it. Five plus two fifty is seven fifty.
Heads up: some restaurants already add a service charge, so check the bill first.
Save this for the next time the check shows up.
So what do you usually tip? Give me a percent.
Send this to the friend who pulls out a calculator at dinner.
